name: ignis
description: IGNIS — AI-powered research platform for NASA microgravity combustion and spacecraft fire-safety data

scripts.web:deploy: npm --prefix web run build && cd web && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --branch=main
scripts.pipeline:all: npm run db:migrate && npm run pipeline:collect && npm run pipeline:clean && npm run pipeline:index && npm run pipeline:analyze
scripts.pipeline:rebuild: npm run db:migrate && npm run pipeline:clean && npm run pipeline:index && npm run pipeline:analyze
